items.title: New ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Mitigate Prompt Injection and Data Exfiltration Risks
items.description: OpenAI has released ChatGPT Lockdown Mode, a new security feature designed to limit outbound network access and reduce the risk of data exfiltration from prompt-injection attacks. The feature is now available to eligible personal accounts, self-serve ChatGPT Business users, and managed enterprise workspaces.
